sylvie: Quick postmortem follow-up for the missing-spans + aggregation drift incident (INC-5842). Need owners and short ETAs.
naveen: I can own the partition backfill + row-level validation. Plan: targeted backfill for affected partitions; ETA Tue EOD.
olivia: I'll take monitoring and runbook edits. Proposal: weekly 'span-coverage' job + alert if processed_span_count drops >20% vs baseline for 30m.
sylvie: Please create obs-remediations tickets, tag with postmortem:INC-5842, and mark quick-fix vs long-term. Assign owners and due dates.
runbook-bot: Created OBS-2001: "etl-partition-backfill" assigned to naveen (due 2026-04-02).
runbook-bot: Created OBS-2002: "span-coverage-weekly" assigned to olivia (due 2026-04-01).
sylvie: This pattern has recurred multiple times; propose a monthly 30-min "obs-regressions" review to triage trends and decide structural fixes. Who can commit?
naveen: I'll attend and bring partition skew metrics and backfill cost estimates.
olivia: I'll host the first session and book the calendar; agenda: recurrence patterns, alert/test gaps, ownership cadence.
sylvie: Everyone drop 1-2 bullets in their ticket by EOD tomorrow (scope, ETA, blockers). I'll schedule 3 weekly check-ins to drive closure. Ping me for blockers. Thanks.
